issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to provide an initializer with the signature init(inventory: [Book]) (problem_statement.md lines 9-12). The reference solution instead defines init(books: [Book]) (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 13-16). This constructor parameter/label mismatch is structural: students implementing the initializer as specified in the problem (init(inventory:)) will produce a different API than the solution and any code/examples that use the solution's initializer (init(books:)). This can lead to failing tests or confusion about which initializer name to use.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the initializer name consistent across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to request init(books: [Book]) or (preferably) change the solution (and any example calls) to implement the initializer with the specified signature init(inventory: [Book]) and ensure the template and tests expect that same label. For example, in the solution change `init(books: [Book])` to `init(inventory: [Book]) { self.books = inventory }` and update any call sites accordingly (e.g. `Bookstore(inventory: books)`).

issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires an initializer with the signature `init(inventory: [Book])`, but the solution implements `init(books: [Book])`. In Swift the external parameter label is part of the signature, so this naming difference means the initializer referenced in the problem does not match the one in the solution. Students will be confused which initializer to implement and could produce code that does not match tests or the reference implementation.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the initializer name consistent across artifacts. Option A (preferred to match the problem): change the solution initializer to `init(inventory: [Book]) { self.books = inventory }`. Option B (if you prefer the solution name): update the problem statement to request `init(books: [Book])` instead of `init(inventory: [Book])`. Ensure tests and templates are updated accordingly.
